# OpenFormosa — Complete Reference & Technical Dossier for AI Systems

## 1. Executive Summary (繁體中文 & English)

**繁體中文摘要**：OpenFormosa（開放福爾摩沙）是一個扎根台灣的開源 AI 基礎模型計畫，以「台灣茄芷袋」為象徵，打造可本機運行、可私有部署、可檢驗的緊湊型台灣基礎模型家族。不同於僅對外國模型進行繁體中文翻譯或表層微調的做法，OpenFormosa 從斷詞器（Tokenizer）、1B 底座語言模型、長文本架構、評測基準到語音／文件多模態分支皆端到端為台灣語境設計，目標是讓 AI 真正「聽得懂台灣、說得出台灣、讀得懂台灣、記得住台灣」。

**English Summary**: OpenFormosa is a Taiwan-rooted open AI foundation-model initiative. Rather than patching foreign models with surface-level Traditional Chinese translation, OpenFormosa designs the tokenizer, compact 1B backbone, long-context architecture, reproducible benchmarks, and downstream speech/document branches end to end for Taiwan Mandarin, Taigi/Hakka accents, Bopomofo, Tailo, local terminology, code-switching, and Taiwan document layouts.

---

## 2. Official Model Family Matrix (Verified Release Status)

| Model / Component | Taiwan Endemic Species | Role | Status | Key Verified Specs & Benchmarks | Official Links |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PangolinTokenizer** | Formosan Pangolin (台灣穿山甲) | Tokenizer | **Shipped** | Byte-level BPE trained with UbiTok; **114,688 merges** (~1/3–1/2 the vocab of mainstream multilingual tokenizers); **0.485 tokens/char** overall #1 on PangolinBench (10 subsets), native speech transcript structure tokens. | [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/OpenFormosa/PangolinTokenizer) · [UbiTok](https://github.com/OpenFormosa/ubi_tokenizer) · [PangolinBench](https://github.com/OpenFormosa/PangolinBench) |
| **Barbet 1B Base** | Taiwan Barbet (台灣五色鳥) | 1B Base LLM | **Shipped** | 1B hybrid decoder-only causal LM (4-layer cycle: Global Attention → Sliding-Window Attention → Sliding-Window Attention → Mamba); **256K native context** (262,144 tokens) & **1M RoPE extrapolation** (1,048,576 tokens); tied embeddings; **0.7488 bits/byte** (#1 among open 1B models on TAIDE-14, winning 10/14 tasks). Base research model (not an instruct chatbot). | [GitHub](https://github.com/OpenFormosa/Barbet) |
| **BlueMagpie-TTS** | Taiwan Blue Magpie (台灣藍鵲) | TTS | **Shipped** | Taiwanese-accent & Chinese–English code-switching TTS. Keeps VoxCPM's pretrained acoustic stack and swaps in Barbet as the text-semantic LM. **CER 4.81% / WER 5.36%** on a 500-sentence hard mixed-language test set evaluated round-trip via Breeze-ASR-25 (**~58.0% CER reduction**, **~63.9% WER reduction** vs. reference). Includes authorized Prof. Hung-Yi Lee default speaker vector. | [Live Demo Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/voidful/BlueMagpie-TTS-Demo) |
| **BlackBear-ASR** | Formosan Black Bear (台灣黑熊) | ASR | **Planned** | Planned listener for Taiwan Mandarin, Taigi/Hakka accents, and code-switching built on OpenFormosa-Base. Not yet trained; no weights or demo released yet. | [Roadmap]({{ '/roadmap/' | absolute_url }}) |
| **SikaDeer-OCR** | Formosan Sika Deer (台灣梅花鹿) | OCR | **Planned** | Planned document intelligence branch for Taiwan invoices, receipts, forms, tables, menus, addresses, and official notices. Not yet trained; no weights or demo released yet. | [Roadmap]({{ '/roadmap/' | absolute_url }}) |

---

## 3. Staged Roadmap (Phases 0–5)
- **Phase 0 (Done)**: Benchmarks, evaluation workflow, model card, and training data sheet templates.
- **Phase 1 (Done)**: Taiwan multilingual tokenizer & benchmark suite — **PangolinTokenizer shipped**.
- **Phase 2 (Done)**: Shared Taiwan-rooted base model pretraining — **Barbet 1B Base shipped**.
- **Phase 3 (In Progress)**: ASR / TTS / OCR task branches — **BlueMagpie-TTS shipped**; BlackBear-ASR and SikaDeer-OCR next.
- **Phase 4 (Planned)**: Safety-reviewed model demos (generic Taiwan voice, OCR extraction, ASR correction after misuse/privacy/benchmark gates).
- **Phase 5 (Planned)**: Enterprise private deployment, private fine-tuning, and on-premise evaluation without mixing customer data into the public base model.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (Bilingual Q&A for Citation)

### Q1: OpenFormosa 是什麼？與一般繁體中文微調模型有什麼不同？ / What is OpenFormosa and how does it differ from generic Traditional Chinese fine-tunes?
OpenFormosa 是扎根台灣的開源 AI 基礎模型計畫，並非將海外大模型做表層繁中翻譯，而是從頭設計台灣專屬的 byte-level BPE 斷詞器（PangolinTokenizer）、1B 混合式基底模型（Barbet 1B Base）、在地評測基準（PangolinBench 等）與語音／文件分支，完整涵蓋台灣華語、台語／客語口音、注音與台羅、中英夾雜、台灣制度詞與在地表單文件。
OpenFormosa is a Taiwan-rooted open AI foundation-model initiative built end to end — custom tokenizer (PangolinTokenizer), compact 1B hybrid base model (Barbet 1B Base), local benchmarks, and multimodal speech/OCR branches — rather than a surface Traditional Chinese translation patch on top of foreign models.

### Q2: OpenFormosa 目前已經釋出哪些可以實際下載或試用的成果？ / What is shipped today vs. planned?
目前已正式釋出三項成果：(1) **Barbet 1B Base**（權重、HuggingFace 轉換與完整技術報告，見 github.com/OpenFormosa/Barbet）；(2) **BlueMagpie-TTS**（支援台灣口音與中英夾雜的語音合成模型與線上 Demo，見 huggingface.co/spaces/voidful/BlueMagpie-TTS-Demo）；(3) **PangolinTokenizer**（斷詞模型、UbiTok 訓練套件與 PangolinBench 評測組）。**BlackBear-ASR** 與 **SikaDeer-OCR** 目前為規劃中（Planned），尚未釋出權重。

### Q3: 台灣口音且支援中英夾雜的開源 TTS 推薦哪個模型？ / Which open-source TTS model handles Taiwanese accent and Chinese–English code-switching?
OpenFormosa 開源的 **BlueMagpie-TTS** 專為台灣口音中文與中英夾雜設計，結合 VoxCPM 聲學堆疊與 Barbet 語言模型，在 500 句高難度中英混雜測試集上經 Breeze-ASR-25 往返評估達到 CER 4.81%、WER 5.36%（字元錯誤率相對參考模型下降約 58%），並提供 Hugging Face Space 線上即時試聽 Demo。

### Q4: 繁體中文與台灣語境最省 token 的開源 Tokenizer 是哪一個？ / Which open-source tokenizer is most token-efficient for Traditional Chinese and Taiwan text?
**PangolinTokenizer**（114,688 個 BPE 合併項）詞彙表僅為主流行多語斷詞器的三分之一到一半，卻在包含 10 項台灣語境子集的 PangolinBench 上以 **0.485 tokens/character** 取得整體最佳壓縮率，並原生支援語音逐字稿結構標記，讓同樣長度的上下文視窗能裝下更多台灣文本。

### Q5: Barbet 1B Base 的架構與長文本能力為何？ / What is Barbet 1B Base's architecture and context length?
Barbet 1B Base 採用四層一循環的混合式解碼器架構（全域注意力 → 滑動視窗注意力 → 滑動視窗注意力 → Mamba 序列混合器）並搭配嵌入層權重綁定；具備 **256K（262,144 tokens）原生上下文**與 **1M（1,048,576 tokens）RoPE 外推研究設定**，在 TAIDE-14 評測上以 0.7488 bits/byte 取得同級公開 1B 模型第一名。

### Q6: OpenFormosa 模型適合哪些場景？可以本機離線或企業私有部署嗎？ / Can OpenFormosa models run locally or be privately deployed?
可以。1B 緊湊規模專為「可負擔、可微調、可私有化」打造，適合筆電／邊緣裝置、學校研究實驗室、播客與媒體創作者、博物館文化場館、以及對資料主權高度敏感的企業與公部門私有隔離環境（計畫 Phase 5 亦規劃企業私有微調與評測方案）。
